text: APPROVE. The extracted helpers preserve the original branch logic: `TryGetApplyIndexes` failing falls through exactly as the old `continue` did, and the closures capture the same values. `BuildPlan`'s remaining complexity (loop, nested `if`, `else if` with `&&`) is well under 15, and I see nothing that would break the build. I could only review the diff, not build it, so a member-ordering analyzer rule on the mid-class `const` is the one thing I couldn't rule out.
